experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form an $f0 dependency chain.

latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency, measured with unroll=100000 and iters=100 to remove per-call overhead. 8 for 0/Inf/NaN; 10 for 1 and powers of two; 23 for 3 and max; 24 with maxsub. The experiment below uses 1.0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: frecip.d $f0, $f8; frecip.d $f1, $f9; frecip.d $f2, $f10; frecip.d $f3, $f11; frecip.d $f4, $f12; frecip.d $f5, $f13; frecip.d $f6, $f14; frecip.d $f7, $f15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4' --asm 'frecip.d $f0, $f8; frecip.d $f1, $f9; frecip.d $f2, $f10; frecip.d $f3, $f11; frecip.d $f4, $f12; frecip.d $f5, $f13; frecip.d $f6, $f14; frecip.d $f7, $f15'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent. 8 independent lanes. CPI ~1.5 for special values, ~2.0 for powers of two, ~5.25 for general inputs, up to ~5.5 with maxsub. CPI is unchanged for 1-20 independent lanes; mixed fast/slow lanes are additive.

notes: Latency and throughput are data-dependent. The latency range was re-measured with unroll=100000; unroll=1000 produced values about 0.2 cycles lower because the per-call overhead was not fully amortised. Throughput is initiation-interval bound: CPI is unchanged from 1 to 20 independent lanes, and mixed fast/slow lanes are additive.
